about.claim_statement: For every passive interferometer U in U(4) acting on the dual-rail Bell pair (qubit A on modes 1-2, qubit B on modes 3-4) with no ancilla, with photon-number-resolving detection of all four output modes, and for every unambiguous assignment of the two-photon detection patterns (each pattern mapped to a Bell state or to failure, a pattern mapped to a Bell state B having zero probability under the other three Bell states), the average success (1/4) sum_B p_B is at most 1/2.
machine_checked: (a) lemma_certificate equals the canonical one-body USD lemma certificate (variables, objective, bound, constraints) and passes core.check_certificate

(b) for every output mode i (m = 4) and Bell pair (B, B'), two polynomial identities in the 2m^2 real entries of U, by exact expansion over Q: (I1) sum_n n_i A_B(n) conj(A_B'(n)) = sum_{j,l} U_ij conj(U_il) H_jl(U^dag U) for every complex matrix U, with A_B(n) = <n|out_B> the permanent polynomials of domain/p3/poly.py bell_amp_poly (cross-validated against both float engines by tests/test_p3_poly_k1.py) and H_jl(G) = <a_l in_B'|Gamma(G)|a_j in_B> written with permanents of G; (I2) sum_{j,l} U_ij conj(U_il) H_jl(I) = <B'| O_A(i)(x)I + I(x)O_B(i) + c_i I |B> with (O_A)_pq = conj(U_ip) U_iq on qubit A's rails, O_B likewise on qubit B's, c_i = |U_i4|^2 for k = 1 (0 for k = 0)
about.setting: m = 4 modes, no ancilla; detection patterns of 2 photons. Bell states in Fock occupations of modes 1-4: phi+- = (|1,0,1,0> +- |0,1,0,1>)/sqrt2, psi+- = (|1,0,0,1> +- |0,1,1,0>)/sqrt2, i.e. the lemma's (|00> +- |11>)/sqrt2 and (|01> +- |10>)/sqrt2 with mode 1 (qubit A) and mode 3 (qubit B) carrying |0>. p_B = sum over patterns mapped to B of Pr[pattern | B].
written_steps: W1: on U(m), U^dag U = I, so the machine-checked identities (I1) and (I2) give D_i[B,B'] := sum_n n_i A_B(n) conj(A_B'(n)) = <B'|Ohat_i|B>, Ohat_i = O_A(i)(x)I + I(x)O_B(i) + c_i I.

W2 (identified patterns are Bell-diagonal): if the assignment sends n to B, unambiguity makes every other Bell amplitude at n zero, so G(n) = A(n)A(n)^dag = |A_B(n)|^2 e_B e_B^T; with E the assigned patterns, Lambda_i := sum_{n in E} n_i G(n) is Bell-diagonal and D_i - Lambda_i = sum_{n not in E} n_i G(n) is PSD.
W3 (transpose): D_i is the transpose of the Bell-basis matrix of Ohat_i; transposition preserves PSD order against a real diagonal matrix, so sum_B (Lambda_i)_BB |B><B| <= Ohat_i as operators.

W4 (rank one): O_A(i) = conj(u)u^T with u = (U_i0, U_i1) is PSD of rank <= 1, i.e. s_A|a><a| with s_A = |U_i0|^2 + |U_i1|^2 and a unit a (any unit a if u = 0); likewise O_B(i); c_i = |U_i4|^2 >= 0 for k = 1. The lemma (P3.one_body_usd_lemma, embedded below and gated by (a)) gives tr Lambda_i <= s_A(i) + s_B(i) + 4 c_i.
W5 (photon count): every pattern has 2 photons, so sum_i tr Lambda_i = 2 * sum_B p_B.
W6 (unit columns): sum_i s_A(i) = sum_i s_B(i) = 2 and sum_i c_i = 0; hence 2 * sum_B p_B <= 4, i.e. (1/4) sum_B p_B <= 1/2, and min_B p_B is at most the average.

lemma_certificate.statement: One-body unambiguous-discrimination lemma (two qubits): let |phi+-> = (|00> +- |11>)/sqrt2 and |psi+-> = (|01> +- |10>)/sqrt2 be the four Bell states B. For unit vectors a, b in C^2, real numbers s_A, s_B, c, and real numbers lambda_B (one for each Bell state B), if s_A |a><a| (x) I + s_B I (x) |b><b| + c I - sum_B lambda_B |B><B| = W W^dagger for some complex 4x4 matrix W, then sum_B lambda_B <= s_A + s_B + 4c.
